title: Object identity result
description: Output of identity computation: canonical key, slug, page_id, and collision status

canonical_key.description: Canonical key: kind+schema+name or kind+schema+name+(types) or migration+path+id

slug.description: Safe filename slug derived from canonical key

page_id.description: New slug--hash.md filename or an explicitly matched existing wiki-relative Markdown path

collision.description: True if page_id collides with an existing page
